ns2:course.label: Chemistry of Lipids in Foods
ns2:course.description: Detailed examination of the chemical and physical properties of lipids in foods. Offered every other year. Prerequisite: A food chemistry or biochemistry course is highly recommended.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: A food chemistry or biochemistry course is highly recommended.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
